name: Villatobas (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Villatobas (fleurs-de-lis and a hand on white).
history: On 3 December 2020 the town council of Villatobas agreed to redefine its arms, and in the same file approved the creation of a flag; the Real Academia de la Historia issued a favourable report on 5 November 2021 and both symbols were approved by the Department of Finance and Public Administrations of Castilla-La Mancha on 24 February 2022. The flag is rectangular, its width two thirds of its length, divided horizontally into two equal parts, white above and blue below; when it bears the municipal arms they are placed at the geometric centre at half the height of the cloth.
